name: Ranjou Karen
source:
A woman of many mysteries appears to collect the debt left behind by Atsushi’s grandfather, the previous owner. She gives him a month-long grace period to complete the repayment. However, she also seems to have some deep connections to the previous owner…

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/games/beat-refle]Gematsu[/url]]
